hook: |
  In 1825 Cauchy proved that the integral of an analytic function around
  any closed curve is zero. To anyone trained on real integrals, this
  seems impossible: surely the integral depends on the path. And for
  non-analytic functions it does. But for analytic functions the
  cancellation is exact — the positive and negative contributions from
  opposite sides of the path perfectly cancel. The Cauchy-Riemann
  equations force both u_y + v_x = 0 and u_x − v_y = 0. Green's theorem
  applied separately to the real and imaginary parts of the loop integral
  converts each to an area integral over one of these expressions; both
  vanish identically.

  The consequences run deep. Knowing an analytic function on a
  circle completely determines its values at every interior point — an
  explicit formula (Cauchy's integral formula) delivers f(z₀) from an
  integral around the boundary. Differentiating that formula gives all
  higher derivatives for free. An analytic function, differentiable once,
  is automatically differentiable infinitely many times.

  Both results matter directly in engineering mathematics. The inverse
  Laplace transform is a contour integral. The residue theorem — the
  subject of the next chapter — converts difficult real integrals to
  residue calculations in seconds.

## Contours and contour integrals

A **contour** (or path) in the complex plane is a **piecewise smooth** curve $C$: $z = z(t)$, $a \leq t \leq b$, where $z(t) = x(t) + iy(t)$ and $z'(t)$ is piecewise continuous. Piecewise smooth means the curve can have finitely many corners, but no cusps or fractal wiggles — at each smooth piece the tangent direction is well-defined.

The **contour integral** of $f$ along $C$ is:

$$\int_C f(z)\,dz = \int_a^b f(z(t))\,z'(t)\,dt$$

This is a real line integral in disguise. Writing $f = u + iv$ and $dz = dx + idy$, multiply out the product:
$$(u + iv)(dx + i\,dy) = u\,dx + iu\,dy + iv\,dx + i^2 v\,dy = (u\,dx - v\,dy) + i(v\,dx + u\,dy)$$

Separating real and imaginary parts:

$$\int_C f\,dz = \int_C(u\,dx - v\,dy) + i\int_C(v\,dx + u\,dy)$$

**Properties.**
- Linearity: $\int_C (\alpha f + \beta g)\,dz = \alpha\int_C f\,dz + \beta\int_C g\,dz$.
- Reversal: $\int_{-C}f\,dz = -\int_C f\,dz$ (reversing the direction negates the integral).
- Additivity: if $C = C_1 + C_2$, then $\int_C = \int_{C_1} + \int_{C_2}$.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// VIZ 1: Path-dependence explorer
// Three simultaneous paths from A=0 to B=1+i; trace slider; integrand selector;
// running-total bars for Re and Im parts. Key moment: all three match for analytic f.
{
  const W = 320, H = 300, SCALE = 110, OX = 40, OY = 260;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const STEPS = 400;

  const intSelector = Inputs.select(
    ["f(z) = z  (analytic)", "f(z) = z\u0305  (not analytic)", "f(z) = |z|\u00b2  (not analytic)"],
    { value: "f(z) = z  (analytic)", label: "Integrand" }
  );
  const traceSlider = Inputs.range([0, 1], { value: 1, step: 0.005, label: "Trace t" });

  function toSx(re) { return OX + re * SCALE; }
  function toSy(im) { return OY - im * SCALE; }

  // Path parametrisations: t in [0,1], endpoint B = 1+i
  function pathStraight(t) { return [t, t]; }
  function pathRightAngle(t) {
    if (t <= 0.5) return [2 * t, 0];
    return [1, 2 * (t - 0.5)];
  }
  function pathSemicircle(t) {
    // Arc from 0 to 1+i via midpoint 0.5 + 0.5i offset by a semicircular bulge
    // Use parametric: goes right along x, then curves up, centre at (0.5, 0.5)
    const theta = Math.PI * t; // 0..pi maps 0 -> bottom -> 1+i via arc
    const cx = 0.5, cy = 0.5, r = Math.sqrt(0.5);
    const angle = -Math.PI / 2 + theta; // start at bottom of circle
    return [cx + r * Math.cos(angle), cy + r * Math.sin(angle)];
  }

  function evalF(fname, re, im) {
    if (fname.startsWith("f(z) = z  ")) return [re, im];
    if (fname.startsWith("f(z) = z\u0305")) return [re, -im];
    return [re * re + im * im, 0]; // |z|^2
  }

  function numericalIntegral(pathFn, fname, upToT) {
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.round(upToT * STEPS));
    const dt = upToT / steps;
    let rA = 0, iA = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < steps; k++) {
      const t0 = k * dt, t1 = (k + 1) * dt;
      const [r0, i0] = pathFn(t0);
      const [r1, i1] = pathFn(t1);
      const mr = (r0 + r1) / 2, mi = (i0 + i1) / 2;
      const dr = r1 - r0, di = i1 - i0;
      const [fr, fi] = evalF(fname, mr, mi);
      // f(z) dz = (fr+i*fi)(dr+i*di) = fr*dr - fi*di + i*(fi*dr + fr*di)
      rA += fr * dr - fi * di;
      iA += fi * dr + fr * di;
    }
    return [rA, iA];
  }

  const PATHS = [
    { name: "Straight", fn: pathStraight, color: "#f97316" },
    { name: "Right-angle", fn: pathRightAngle, color: "#3b82f6" },
    { name: "Semicircle", fn: pathSemicircle, color: "#8b5cf6" }
  ];

  function buildSVG(fname, tVal) {
    const svg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width", W); svg.setAttribute("height", H);
    svg.style.cssText = "background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";

    // Grid lines
    for (let v = 0; v <= 2; v++) {
      const gv = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
      gv.setAttribute("x1", toSx(v)); gv.setAttribute("y1", toSy(-0.3));
      gv.setAttribute("x2", toSx(v)); gv.setAttribute("y2", toSy(1.6));
      gv.setAttribute("stroke", "#e5e7eb"); gv.setAttribute("stroke-width", "0.5");
      svg.appendChild(gv);
    }
    for (let u = 0; u <= 2; u++) {
      const gh = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
      gh.setAttribute("x1", toSx(-0.1)); gh.setAttribute("y1", toSy(u));
      gh.setAttribute("x2", toSx(1.6)); gh.setAttribute("y2", toSy(u));
      gh.setAttribute("stroke", "#e5e7eb"); gh.setAttribute("stroke-width", "0.5");
      svg.appendChild(gh);
    }

    // Axes
    const axH = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    axH.setAttribute("x1", toSx(-0.1)); axH.setAttribute("y1", toSy(0));
    axH.setAttribute("x2", toSx(1.6)); axH.setAttribute("y2", toSy(0));
    axH.setAttribute("stroke", "#9ca3af"); axH.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.2");
    svg.appendChild(axH);
    const axV = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    axV.setAttribute("x1", toSx(0)); axV.setAttribute("y1", toSy(-0.2));
    axV.setAttribute("x2", toSx(0)); axV.setAttribute("y2", toSy(1.6));
    axV.setAttribute("stroke", "#9ca3af"); axV.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.2");
    svg.appendChild(axV);

    // Axis labels
    const lblRe = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    lblRe.setAttribute("x", toSx(1.55)); lblRe.setAttribute("y", toSy(0) - 6);
    lblRe.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); lblRe.setAttribute("fill", "#6b7280");
    lblRe.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); lblRe.textContent = "Re";
    svg.appendChild(lblRe);
    const lblIm = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    lblIm.setAttribute("x", toSx(0) + 4); lblIm.setAttribute("y", toSy(1.55));
    lblIm.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); lblIm.setAttribute("fill", "#6b7280");
    lblIm.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); lblIm.textContent = "Im";
    svg.appendChild(lblIm);

    // Draw full ghost paths
    for (const p of PATHS) {
      let d = "";
      for (let k = 0; k <= STEPS; k++) {
        const [re, im] = p.fn(k / STEPS);
        d += (k === 0 ? "M" : "L") + ` ${toSx(re)} ${toSy(im)}`;
      }
      const ghost = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "path");
      ghost.setAttribute("d", d); ghost.setAttribute("fill", "none");
      ghost.setAttribute("stroke", p.color); ghost.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.5");
      ghost.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", "4,3"); ghost.setAttribute("opacity", "0.35");
      svg.appendChild(ghost);
    }

    // Draw traced portions
    for (const p of PATHS) {
      const steps = Math.round(tVal * STEPS);
      let d = "";
      for (let k = 0; k <= steps; k++) {
        const [re, im] = p.fn(k / STEPS);
        d += (k === 0 ? "M" : "L") + ` ${toSx(re)} ${toSy(im)}`;
      }
      const trace = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "path");
      trace.setAttribute("d", d); trace.setAttribute("fill", "none");
      trace.setAttribute("stroke", p.color); trace.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2.5");
      svg.appendChild(trace);

      // Moving dot
      const [cr, ci] = p.fn(tVal);
      const dot = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "circle");
      dot.setAttribute("cx", toSx(cr)); dot.setAttribute("cy", toSy(ci));
      dot.setAttribute("r", "5"); dot.setAttribute("fill", p.color);
      dot.setAttribute("stroke", "#fff"); dot.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.5");
      svg.appendChild(dot);
    }

    // A and B endpoint markers
    const A = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "circle");
    A.setAttribute("cx", toSx(0)); A.setAttribute("cy", toSy(0));
    A.setAttribute("r", "5"); A.setAttribute("fill", "#111827");
    A.setAttribute("stroke", "#fff"); A.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.5");
    svg.appendChild(A);
    const Albl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    Albl.setAttribute("x", toSx(0) + 7); Albl.setAttribute("y", toSy(0) - 5);
    Albl.setAttribute("font-size", "11"); Albl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif");
    Albl.setAttribute("fill", "#111827"); Albl.textContent = "A = 0";
    svg.appendChild(Albl);
    const B = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "circle");
    B.setAttribute("cx", toSx(1)); B.setAttribute("cy", toSy(1));
    B.setAttribute("r", "5"); B.setAttribute("fill", "#111827");
    B.setAttribute("stroke", "#fff"); B.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.5");
    svg.appendChild(B);
    const Blbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    Blbl.setAttribute("x", toSx(1) + 7); Blbl.setAttribute("y", toSy(1) - 5);
    Blbl.setAttribute("font-size", "11"); Blbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif");
    Blbl.setAttribute("fill", "#111827"); Blbl.textContent = "B = 1+i";
    svg.appendChild(Blbl);

    return svg;
  }

  function buildBars(fname, tVal) {
    const BAR_W = 260, BAR_H = 200;
    const svg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width", BAR_W); svg.setAttribute("height", BAR_H);
    svg.style.cssText = "display:block;";

    const integrals = PATHS.map(p => numericalIntegral(p.fn, fname, tVal));
    const maxVal = Math.max(1e-9, ...integrals.flatMap(([r, i]) => [Math.abs(r), Math.abs(i)]));
    const barScale = 70 / maxVal;
    const colW = 60, midY = 110, lblY = BAR_H - 10;

    // Zero line
    const zl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    zl.setAttribute("x1", 10); zl.setAttribute("y1", midY);
    zl.setAttribute("x2", BAR_W - 10); zl.setAttribute("y2", midY);
    zl.setAttribute("stroke", "#d1d5db"); zl.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1");
    svg.appendChild(zl);

    const headRe = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    headRe.setAttribute("x", "10"); headRe.setAttribute("y", "14");
    headRe.setAttribute("font-size", "9"); headRe.setAttribute("fill", "#6b7280");
    headRe.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); headRe.textContent = "Re(\u222bf dz)";
    svg.appendChild(headRe);
    const headIm = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    headIm.setAttribute("x", "135"); headIm.setAttribute("y", "14");
    headIm.setAttribute("font-size", "9"); headIm.setAttribute("fill", "#6b7280");
    headIm.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); headIm.textContent = "Im(\u222bf dz)";
    svg.appendChild(headIm);

    for (let i = 0; i < PATHS.length; i++) {
      const [rv, iv] = integrals[i];
      const col = PATHS[i].color;
      const name = PATHS[i].name;
      const xR = 14 + i * 38, xI = 140 + i * 38;

      // Re bar
      const rh = rv * barScale;
      const reBar = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "rect");
      reBar.setAttribute("x", xR); reBar.setAttribute("y", rh >= 0 ? midY - rh : midY);
      reBar.setAttribute("width", 30); reBar.setAttribute("height", Math.max(2, Math.abs(rh)));
      reBar.setAttribute("fill", col); reBar.setAttribute("rx", "2");
      svg.appendChild(reBar);
      const reVal = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
      reVal.setAttribute("x", xR + 15); reVal.setAttribute("y", rh >= 0 ? midY - rh - 3 : midY + Math.abs(rh) + 11);
      reVal.setAttribute("font-size", "8"); reVal.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
      reVal.setAttribute("fill", col); reVal.setAttribute("font-family", "monospace");
      reVal.textContent = rv.toFixed(3);
      svg.appendChild(reVal);

      // Im bar
      const ih = iv * barScale;
      const imBar = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "rect");
      imBar.setAttribute("x", xI); imBar.setAttribute("y", ih >= 0 ? midY - ih : midY);
      imBar.setAttribute("width", 30); imBar.setAttribute("height", Math.max(2, Math.abs(ih)));
      imBar.setAttribute("fill", col); imBar.setAttribute("rx", "2");
      svg.appendChild(imBar);
      const imVal = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
      imVal.setAttribute("x", xI + 15); imVal.setAttribute("y", ih >= 0 ? midY - ih - 3 : midY + Math.abs(ih) + 11);
      imVal.setAttribute("font-size", "8"); imVal.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
      imVal.setAttribute("fill", col); imVal.setAttribute("font-family", "monospace");
      imVal.textContent = iv.toFixed(3) + "i";
      svg.appendChild(imVal);

      // Path label
      const lbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
      lbl.setAttribute("x", (xR + xI) / 2 - 6); lbl.setAttribute("y", lblY);
      lbl.setAttribute("font-size", "8"); lbl.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
      lbl.setAttribute("fill", col); lbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif");
      lbl.textContent = name;
      svg.appendChild(lbl);
    }

    // Agreement indicator
    const vals = integrals;
    const reClose = Math.abs(vals[0][0] - vals[1][0]) < 0.01 && Math.abs(vals[1][0] - vals[2][0]) < 0.01;
    const imClose = Math.abs(vals[0][1] - vals[1][1]) < 0.01 && Math.abs(vals[1][1] - vals[2][1]) < 0.01;
    const agree = reClose && imClose;
    const annot = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    annot.setAttribute("x", BAR_W / 2); annot.setAttribute("y", BAR_H - 26);
    annot.setAttribute("font-size", "9"); annot.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    annot.setAttribute("font-weight", "bold");
    annot.setAttribute("fill", agree ? "#059669" : "#dc2626");
    annot.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif");
    annot.textContent = agree ? "all three agree \u2014 path-independent" : "values differ \u2014 path-dependent";
    svg.appendChild(annot);

    return svg;
  }

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0; font-family:sans-serif;";

  const title = document.createElement("div");
  title.style.cssText = "font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem;";
  title.textContent = "Path-dependence explorer: three paths from A to B";
  container.appendChild(title);

  container.appendChild(intSelector);
  container.appendChild(traceSlider);

  const panels = document.createElement("div");
  panels.style.cssText = "display:flex; gap:1rem; align-items:flex-start; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:0.5rem;";

  const svgDiv = document.createElement("div");
  const barDiv = document.createElement("div");
  panels.appendChild(svgDiv);
  panels.appendChild(barDiv);
  container.appendChild(panels);

  // Legend
  const legend = document.createElement("div");
  legend.style.cssText = "display:flex; gap:1rem; margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.82em;";
  for (const p of PATHS) {
    const item = document.createElement("span");
    item.style.cssText = `color:${p.color};`;
    item.textContent = "\u25ac " + p.name;
    legend.appendChild(item);
  }
  container.appendChild(legend);

  const note = document.createElement("div");
  note.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  note.textContent = "Drag the trace slider to advance all three paths simultaneously. For f(z) = z (analytic) every path gives the same result — path independence. Switch to z\u0305 or |z|\u00b2 and the bars diverge.";
  container.appendChild(note);

  function update() {
    const fname = intSelector.value;
    const tVal = traceSlider.value;
    svgDiv.innerHTML = ""; svgDiv.appendChild(buildSVG(fname, tVal));
    barDiv.innerHTML = ""; barDiv.appendChild(buildBars(fname, tVal));
  }
  intSelector.addEventListener("input", update);
  traceSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  update();

  return container;
}
```

### The ML inequality

When you need a bound on a contour integral rather than its exact value, the ML inequality is the standard tool:

$$\left|\int_C f(z)\,dz\right| \leq M \cdot L$$

where $M = \max_{z \in C}|f(z)|$ and $L$ is the arc length of $C$. This mirrors the real estimate $|\int_a^b f\,dx| \leq \max|f| \cdot (b-a)$. The application section below shows how to read off $M$ and $L$ in practice.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// VIZ 6: ML inequality geometry
// Contour in z-plane with perpendicular spike magnitudes; M and L labels;
// bounding rectangle vs actual integral bar in right panel.
{
  const W = 340, H = 260, SCALE = 70, OX = 100, OY = 160;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const STEPS = 120;

  const radiusML = Inputs.range([0.4, 2.2], { value: 1.2, step: 0.05, label: "Contour radius R" });
  const funcML = Inputs.select(
    ["f(z) = 1/z\u00b2", "f(z) = e^z", "f(z) = 1/(z+2)"],
    { value: "f(z) = 1/z\u00b2", label: "f(z)" }
  );

  function toSx(re) { return OX + re * SCALE; }
  function toSy(im) { return OY - im * SCALE; }

  function fMagnitude(fname, re, im) {
    if (fname === "f(z) = 1/z\u00b2") {
      const d2 = re*re + im*im;
      return d2 < 1e-8 ? 99 : 1 / d2;
    }
    if (fname === "f(z) = e^z") return Math.exp(re);
    const dr = re + 2, d = dr*dr + im*im;
    return d < 1e-10 ? 99 : 1 / Math.sqrt(d);
  }

  function build(R, fname) {
    const svg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width", W); svg.setAttribute("height", H);
    svg.style.cssText = "background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";

    // Axes
    for (const [x1,y1,x2,y2] of [
      [toSx(-0.2), toSy(0), toSx(2.4), toSy(0)],
      [toSx(0), toSy(-1.8), toSx(0), toSy(2.0)]
    ]) {
      const ax = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
      ax.setAttribute("x1",x1); ax.setAttribute("y1",y1);
      ax.setAttribute("x2",x2); ax.setAttribute("y2",y2);
      ax.setAttribute("stroke","#d1d5db"); ax.setAttribute("stroke-width","1");
      svg.appendChild(ax);
    }

    // Contour circle and spike magnitudes
    const mags = [];
    let dPath = "";
    for (let k = 0; k <= STEPS; k++) {
      const theta = (2 * Math.PI * k) / STEPS;
      const re = R * Math.cos(theta), im = R * Math.sin(theta);
      const m = fMagnitude(fname, re, im);
      mags.push(Math.min(m, 4)); // cap display
      dPath += (k === 0 ? "M" : "L") + ` ${toSx(re)} ${toSy(im)}`;
    }
    const contour = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "path");
    contour.setAttribute("d", dPath); contour.setAttribute("fill", "none");
    contour.setAttribute("stroke", "#3b82f6"); contour.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
    svg.appendChild(contour);

    // Spikes
    const SPIKE_SCALE = 20;
    for (let k = 0; k < STEPS; k += 6) {
      const theta = (2 * Math.PI * k) / STEPS;
      const re = R * Math.cos(theta), im = R * Math.sin(theta);
      const sx = toSx(re), sy = toSy(im);
      // Outward normal direction
      const nx = Math.cos(theta), ny = -Math.sin(theta); // screen normal (y flipped)
      const h = Math.min(mags[k], 3.5) * SPIKE_SCALE;
      const ex = sx + nx * h, ey = sy + ny * h;
      const spike = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
      spike.setAttribute("x1", sx); spike.setAttribute("y1", sy);
      spike.setAttribute("x2", ex); spike.setAttribute("y2", ey);
      spike.setAttribute("stroke", "#f97316"); spike.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.5");
      spike.setAttribute("opacity", "0.7");
      svg.appendChild(spike);
    }

    // M = max on contour, L = arc length = 2πR
    const Mval = Math.max(...mags);
    const Lval = 2 * Math.PI * R;
    const ML = Mval * Lval;

    // M level ring
    const mlCircle = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "circle");
    mlCircle.setAttribute("cx", toSx(0)); mlCircle.setAttribute("cy", toSy(0));
    mlCircle.setAttribute("r", (R + Math.min(Mval, 3.5) * (SPIKE_SCALE / SCALE)));
    mlCircle.setAttribute("fill", "none"); mlCircle.setAttribute("stroke", "#dc2626");
    mlCircle.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1"); mlCircle.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", "3,3");
    svg.appendChild(mlCircle);

    // Labels
    const mlbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    mlbl.setAttribute("x", toSx(R) + 4); mlbl.setAttribute("y", toSy(0) - 4);
    mlbl.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); mlbl.setAttribute("fill", "#f97316");
    mlbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); mlbl.textContent = "M = " + Mval.toFixed(2);
    svg.appendChild(mlbl);
    const llbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    llbl.setAttribute("x", toSx(0) + 4); llbl.setAttribute("y", toSy(-R) + 14);
    llbl.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); llbl.setAttribute("fill", "#3b82f6");
    llbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); llbl.textContent = "L = 2\u03c0R = " + Lval.toFixed(2);
    svg.appendChild(llbl);

    // Contour label
    const clbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    clbl.setAttribute("x", 4); clbl.setAttribute("y", 14);
    clbl.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); clbl.setAttribute("fill", "#3b82f6");
    clbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); clbl.textContent = "C: |z| = " + R.toFixed(2);
    svg.appendChild(clbl);

    // Bar panel on right
    const BX = W - 100, BY = 20, BW = 80, BH = H - 50;
    const bg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "rect");
    bg.setAttribute("x", BX); bg.setAttribute("y", BY);
    bg.setAttribute("width", BW); bg.setAttribute("height", BH);
    bg.setAttribute("fill", "#f9fafb"); bg.setAttribute("rx", "4");
    svg.appendChild(bg);

    // Actual |∮ f dz| — numerical estimate via trapezoidal sum
    let sumRe = 0, sumIm = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < STEPS; k++) {
      const t0 = (2*Math.PI*k)/STEPS, t1 = (2*Math.PI*(k+1))/STEPS;
      const r0 = R*Math.cos(t0), i0 = R*Math.sin(t0);
      const r1 = R*Math.cos(t1), i1 = R*Math.sin(t1);
      const mr = (r0+r1)/2, mi = (i0+i1)/2;
      const dr = r1-r0, di = i1-i0;
      // f(z) evaluation
      let fr, fi;
      if (fname === "f(z) = 1/z\u00b2") {
        const d2 = mr*mr+mi*mi; if (d2<1e-8) continue;
        const re2 = (mr*mr-mi*mi)/(d2*d2), im2 = (-2*mr*mi)/(d2*d2);
        fr = re2; fi = im2;
      } else if (fname === "f(z) = e^z") {
        fr = Math.exp(mr)*Math.cos(mi); fi = Math.exp(mr)*Math.sin(mi);
      } else {
        const ddr = mr+2, d = ddr*ddr+mi*mi; if (d<1e-10) continue;
        fr = ddr/d; fi = -mi/d;
      }
      sumRe += fr*dr - fi*di;
      sumIm += fi*dr + fr*di;
    }
    const actual = Math.sqrt(sumRe*sumRe + sumIm*sumIm);
    const maxBar = Math.max(ML, actual, 0.1);
    const mlH = (ML / maxBar) * (BH - 30);
    const actH = (actual / maxBar) * (BH - 30);

    // ML bar
    const mlBar = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "rect");
    mlBar.setAttribute("x", BX + 8); mlBar.setAttribute("y", BY + BH - 20 - mlH);
    mlBar.setAttribute("width", 24); mlBar.setAttribute("height", mlH);
    mlBar.setAttribute("fill", "#dc2626"); mlBar.setAttribute("rx", "2");
    svg.appendChild(mlBar);
    const mlBarLbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    mlBarLbl.setAttribute("x", BX + 20); mlBarLbl.setAttribute("y", BY + BH - 22 - mlH);
    mlBarLbl.setAttribute("font-size", "8"); mlBarLbl.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    mlBarLbl.setAttribute("fill", "#dc2626"); mlBarLbl.setAttribute("font-family", "monospace");
    mlBarLbl.textContent = "ML"; svg.appendChild(mlBarLbl);
    const mlNum = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    mlNum.setAttribute("x", BX + 20); mlNum.setAttribute("y", BY + BH - 8);
    mlNum.setAttribute("font-size", "8"); mlNum.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    mlNum.setAttribute("fill", "#dc2626"); mlNum.setAttribute("font-family", "monospace");
    mlNum.textContent = ML.toFixed(2); svg.appendChild(mlNum);

    // Actual bar
    const actBar = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "rect");
    actBar.setAttribute("x", BX + 46); actBar.setAttribute("y", BY + BH - 20 - actH);
    actBar.setAttribute("width", 24); actBar.setAttribute("height", actH);
    actBar.setAttribute("fill", "#3b82f6"); actBar.setAttribute("rx", "2");
    svg.appendChild(actBar);
    const actBarLbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    actBarLbl.setAttribute("x", BX + 58); actBarLbl.setAttribute("y", BY + BH - 22 - actH);
    actBarLbl.setAttribute("font-size", "8"); actBarLbl.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    actBarLbl.setAttribute("fill", "#3b82f6"); actBarLbl.setAttribute("font-family", "monospace");
    actBarLbl.textContent = "|\u222bf dz|"; svg.appendChild(actBarLbl);
    const actNum = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    actNum.setAttribute("x", BX + 58); actNum.setAttribute("y", BY + BH - 8);
    actNum.setAttribute("font-size", "8"); actNum.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    actNum.setAttribute("fill", "#3b82f6"); actNum.setAttribute("font-family", "monospace");
    actNum.textContent = actual.toFixed(2); svg.appendChild(actNum);

    return svg;
  }

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0; font-family:sans-serif;";

  const titleEl = document.createElement("div");
  titleEl.style.cssText = "font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem;";
  titleEl.textContent = "ML inequality: spikes show |f(z)| along the contour";
  container.appendChild(titleEl);
  container.appendChild(radiusML);
  container.appendChild(funcML);

  const vizDiv = document.createElement("div");
  vizDiv.style.marginTop = "0.5rem";
  container.appendChild(vizDiv);

  const noteEl = document.createElement("div");
  noteEl.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  noteEl.textContent = "Orange spikes show |f(z)| at each point of the contour. M is the tallest spike; L is the arc length. The red bar (ML) is the bound; the blue bar (|\u222bf dz|) is the actual magnitude. The bound always wins.";
  container.appendChild(noteEl);

  function update() {
    vizDiv.innerHTML = "";
    vizDiv.appendChild(build(radiusML.value, funcML.value));
  }
  radiusML.addEventListener("input", update);
  funcML.addEventListener("input", update);
  update();

  return container;
}
```

### Integral of $1/z^{n+1}$ around a circle

$$\oint_{|z|=r} \frac{dz}{z^{n+1}} = \begin{cases} 2\pi i & n = 0 \\ 0 & n \neq 0 \end{cases}$$

*Proof for $n=0$:* parametrise $z = re^{i\theta}$, $dz = ire^{i\theta}d\theta$:
$$\int_0^{2\pi}\frac{ire^{i\theta}}{re^{i\theta}}\,d\theta = \int_0^{2\pi}i\,d\theta = 2\pi i$$

This single result — that the integral of $1/z$ around the origin is $2\pi i$ — is the seed from which the residue theorem grows.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// VIZ 5: 1/z^{n+1} circle integral — discrete n slider, θ trace with play button,
// integrand arrows, two strip-chart accumulators, green highlight when n=0 gives 2πi.
{
  const W = 340, H = 300, SCALE = 85, CX = 155, CY = 155;
  const BARY = 260, BARH = 30, BARW = 250, BARX = 55;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const STEPS = 360;

  const nSlider = Inputs.range([-2, 3], { value: 0, step: 1, label: "n  (integrand = 1/z^{n+1})" });
  const thetaSlider = Inputs.range([0, 1], { value: 0, step: 0.005, label: "Trace \u03b8/2\u03c0" });
  const playBtn = document.createElement("button");
  playBtn.textContent = "Play \u25b6";
  playBtn.style.cssText = "padding:0.3rem 0.8rem; border:1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius:4px; background:#fff; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.88em; margin-top:0.3rem;";

  function computeCircleIntegral(n, upToTheta) {
    // z = e^{i*theta}, dz = i*e^{i*theta}*dtheta
    // 1/z^{n+1} * dz = e^{-i*(n+1)*theta} * i*e^{i*theta} * dtheta = i * e^{-i*n*theta} * dtheta
    // Integral from 0 to 2pi*upToTheta
    const T = 2 * Math.PI * upToTheta;
    if (Math.abs(n) < 0.01) {
      // n=0: integral = i * T
      return [0, T];
    }
    // n != 0: i * integral of e^{-i*n*theta} dtheta = i * [e^{-i*n*theta}/(-i*n)]_0^T
    //       = i * (e^{-i*n*T} - 1) / (-i*n) = (e^{-i*n*T} - 1) / (-n)
    const cosT = Math.cos(n * T), sinT = Math.sin(n * T);
    const re = (cosT - 1) / (-n);
    const im = (-sinT) / (-n);
    return [re, im];
  }

  function toSx(re) { return CX + re * SCALE; }
  function toSy(im) { return CY - im * SCALE; }

  function buildViz(n, thetaFrac) {
    const svg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width", W); svg.setAttribute("height", H + 70);
    svg.style.cssText = "background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";

    // Axes
    const ax = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    ax.setAttribute("x1", toSx(-1.6)); ax.setAttribute("y1", toSy(0));
    ax.setAttribute("x2", toSx(1.6)); ax.setAttribute("y2", toSy(0));
    ax.setAttribute("stroke", "#d1d5db"); ax.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1");
    svg.appendChild(ax);
    const ay = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    ay.setAttribute("x1", toSx(0)); ay.setAttribute("y1", toSy(-1.6));
    ay.setAttribute("x2", toSx(0)); ay.setAttribute("y2", toSy(1.6));
    ay.setAttribute("stroke", "#d1d5db"); ay.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1");
    svg.appendChild(ay);

    // Unit circle (ghost)
    const circle = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "circle");
    circle.setAttribute("cx", toSx(0)); circle.setAttribute("cy", toSy(0));
    circle.setAttribute("r", SCALE); circle.setAttribute("fill", "none");
    circle.setAttribute("stroke", "#e5e7eb"); circle.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.5");
    svg.appendChild(circle);

    // Traced arc
    const arcSteps = Math.round(thetaFrac * STEPS);
    if (arcSteps > 1) {
      let arcD = "";
      for (let k = 0; k <= arcSteps; k++) {
        const theta = (2 * Math.PI * k) / STEPS;
        const px = toSx(Math.cos(theta)), py = toSy(Math.sin(theta));
        arcD += (k === 0 ? "M" : "L") + ` ${px} ${py}`;
      }
      const arcEl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "path");
      arcEl.setAttribute("d", arcD); arcEl.setAttribute("fill", "none");
      arcEl.setAttribute("stroke", "#8b5cf6"); arcEl.setAttribute("stroke-width", "3");
      svg.appendChild(arcEl);
    }

    // Current point on circle
    const theta0 = 2 * Math.PI * thetaFrac;
    const cx = Math.cos(theta0), cy = Math.sin(theta0);
    const cpx = toSx(cx), cpy = toSy(cy);
    const pt = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "circle");
    pt.setAttribute("cx", cpx); pt.setAttribute("cy", cpy);
    pt.setAttribute("r", "6"); pt.setAttribute("fill", "#8b5cf6");
    pt.setAttribute("stroke", "#fff"); pt.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
    svg.appendChild(pt);

    // Integrand arrow at current point: 1/z^{n+1} * dz/dtheta direction
    // dz/dtheta = i*e^{i*theta}; 1/z^{n+1} = e^{-i*(n+1)*theta}
    // product = i * e^{-i*n*theta}
    const arrowRe = -Math.sin(n * theta0);
    const arrowIm = Math.cos(n * theta0);
    const arrowLen = 22;
    const arrowNorm = Math.sqrt(arrowRe*arrowRe + arrowIm*arrowIm) || 1;
    const adx = (arrowRe / arrowNorm) * arrowLen;
    const ady = -(arrowIm / arrowNorm) * arrowLen; // screen y-flip
    const arrowEl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    arrowEl.setAttribute("x1", cpx); arrowEl.setAttribute("y1", cpy);
    arrowEl.setAttribute("x2", cpx + adx); arrowEl.setAttribute("y2", cpy + ady);
    arrowEl.setAttribute("stroke", "#f97316"); arrowEl.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
    arrowEl.setAttribute("marker-end", "url(#arrow-orange)");
    svg.appendChild(arrowEl);

    // Arrow marker def
    const defs = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "defs");
    const marker = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "marker");
    marker.setAttribute("id", "arrow-orange"); marker.setAttribute("markerWidth", "6");
    marker.setAttribute("markerHeight", "6"); marker.setAttribute("refX", "5");
    marker.setAttribute("refY", "3"); marker.setAttribute("orient", "auto");
    const poly = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "polygon");
    poly.setAttribute("points", "0 0, 6 3, 0 6"); poly.setAttribute("fill", "#f97316");
    marker.appendChild(poly); defs.appendChild(marker); svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);

    // Origin ×
    const ox = toSx(0), oy2 = toSy(0);
    const xSz = 5;
    for (const [dx, dy] of [[-xSz,-xSz],[xSz,xSz],[xSz,-xSz],[-xSz,xSz]].slice(0,2)) {
      const line = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
      line.setAttribute("x1", ox+dx); line.setAttribute("y1", oy2+dy);
      line.setAttribute("x2", ox-dx); line.setAttribute("y2", oy2-dy);
      line.setAttribute("stroke", "#ef4444"); line.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
      svg.appendChild(line);
    }

    // Axis labels
    const relbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    relbl.setAttribute("x", toSx(1.5)); relbl.setAttribute("y", toSy(0) - 5);
    relbl.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); relbl.setAttribute("fill", "#9ca3af");
    relbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); relbl.textContent = "Re";
    svg.appendChild(relbl);

    // Strip charts below
    const [intRe, intIm] = computeCircleIntegral(n, thetaFrac);
    const finalIm = n === 0 ? 2 * Math.PI : 0;
    const isN0 = Math.abs(n) < 0.01;
    const maxVal = Math.max(1e-6, 2 * Math.PI * 1.1);
    const baseY = H + 8;

    // Re strip
    const reLabel = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    reLabel.setAttribute("x", 4); reLabel.setAttribute("y", baseY + 15);
    reLabel.setAttribute("font-size", "9"); reLabel.setAttribute("fill", "#6b7280");
    reLabel.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); reLabel.textContent = "Re";
    svg.appendChild(reLabel);
    const reBg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "rect");
    reBg.setAttribute("x", BARX); reBg.setAttribute("y", baseY);
    reBg.setAttribute("width", BARW); reBg.setAttribute("height", BARH * 0.7);
    reBg.setAttribute("fill", "#f3f4f6"); reBg.setAttribute("rx", "3");
    svg.appendChild(reBg);
    const reW = (Math.abs(intRe) / maxVal) * BARW;
    const reBar = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "rect");
    reBar.setAttribute("x", BARX); reBar.setAttribute("y", baseY);
    reBar.setAttribute("width", Math.min(reW, BARW)); reBar.setAttribute("height", BARH * 0.7);
    reBar.setAttribute("fill", "#3b82f6"); reBar.setAttribute("rx", "3");
    svg.appendChild(reBar);
    const reVal = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    reVal.setAttribute("x", BARX + Math.min(reW, BARW) + 4); reVal.setAttribute("y", baseY + 14);
    reVal.setAttribute("font-size", "9"); reVal.setAttribute("fill", "#374151");
    reVal.setAttribute("font-family", "monospace"); reVal.textContent = intRe.toFixed(3);
    svg.appendChild(reVal);

    // Im strip
    const imLabel = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    imLabel.setAttribute("x", 4); imLabel.setAttribute("y", baseY + BARH + 15);
    imLabel.setAttribute("font-size", "9"); imLabel.setAttribute("fill", "#6b7280");
    imLabel.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); imLabel.textContent = "Im";
    svg.appendChild(imLabel);
    const imBg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "rect");
    imBg.setAttribute("x", BARX); imBg.setAttribute("y", baseY + BARH);
    imBg.setAttribute("width", BARW); imBg.setAttribute("height", BARH * 0.7);
    imBg.setAttribute("fill", "#f3f4f6"); imBg.setAttribute("rx", "3");
    svg.appendChild(imBg);
    const imW = (Math.abs(intIm) / maxVal) * BARW;
    const imBar = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "rect");
    imBar.setAttribute("x", BARX); imBar.setAttribute("y", baseY + BARH);
    imBar.setAttribute("width", Math.min(imW, BARW)); imBar.setAttribute("height", BARH * 0.7);
    const imFill = isN0 && thetaFrac > 0.95 ? "#059669" : "#8b5cf6";
    imBar.setAttribute("fill", imFill); imBar.setAttribute("rx", "3");
    svg.appendChild(imBar);
    const imVal = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    imVal.setAttribute("x", BARX + Math.min(imW, BARW) + 4); imVal.setAttribute("y", baseY + BARH + 14);
    imVal.setAttribute("font-size", "9"); imVal.setAttribute("fill", "#374151");
    imVal.setAttribute("font-family", "monospace"); imVal.textContent = intIm.toFixed(3) + "i";
    svg.appendChild(imVal);

    // n=0 result highlight
    if (isN0 && thetaFrac > 0.95) {
      const hl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
      hl.setAttribute("x", W / 2); hl.setAttribute("y", H - 5);
      hl.setAttribute("font-size", "11"); hl.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
      hl.setAttribute("fill", "#059669"); hl.setAttribute("font-weight", "bold");
      hl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif");
      hl.textContent = "n = 0 \u2192 \u222e dz/z = 2\u03c0i";
      svg.appendChild(hl);
    }

    return svg;
  }

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0; font-family:sans-serif;";

  const titleEl = document.createElement("div");
  titleEl.style.cssText = "font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem;";
  titleEl.textContent = "\u222e dz / z^{n+1} around the unit circle";
  container.appendChild(titleEl);
  container.appendChild(nSlider);
  container.appendChild(thetaSlider);
  container.appendChild(playBtn);

  const vizDiv = document.createElement("div");
  vizDiv.style.marginTop = "0.5rem";
  container.appendChild(vizDiv);

  const noteEl = document.createElement("div");
  noteEl.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  noteEl.textContent = "The orange arrow shows the integrand 1/z^{n+1} \u00b7 dz/d\u03b8 at the current point. The strip charts accumulate the real and imaginary parts of the integral as \u03b8 advances. Only n = 0 gives a non-zero result (2\u03c0i), highlighted in green at completion.";
  container.appendChild(noteEl);

  let animFrame = null, playing = false;
  playBtn.onclick = () => {
    if (playing) {
      playing = false; playBtn.textContent = "Play \u25b6";
      if (animFrame) cancelAnimationFrame(animFrame);
    } else {
      playing = true; playBtn.textContent = "Pause \u23f8";
      if (thetaSlider.value >= 1) thetaSlider.value = 0;
      function step() {
        if (!playing) return;
        thetaSlider.value = Math.min(1, thetaSlider.value + 0.004);
        thetaSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event("input"));
        if (thetaSlider.value < 1) animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
        else { playing = false; playBtn.textContent = "Play \u25b6"; }
      }
      animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
  };

  function update() {
    vizDiv.innerHTML = "";
    vizDiv.appendChild(buildViz(nSlider.value, thetaSlider.value));
  }
  nSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  thetaSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  update();

  return container;
}
```

## Cauchy's theorem

**Cauchy-Goursat theorem.** If $f$ is analytic throughout a simply connected domain $D$ (no holes — defined in Chapter 1), then for every closed contour $C$ in $D$:

$$\oint_C f(z)\,dz = 0$$

*Intuition.* Because the domain has no holes, any closed curve can be continuously shrunk to a point. The integral shrinks with it — to zero.

**Consequence: path independence.** If $f$ is analytic in a simply connected domain and $C_1$, $C_2$ are two paths from $z_1$ to $z_2$ in that domain, then $\int_{C_1}f\,dz = \int_{C_2}f\,dz$. The integral depends only on the endpoints, not the path.

**Deformation principle.** If $f$ is analytic everywhere between two contours $C_1$ and $C_2$ (with the same orientation), then $\int_{C_1}f\,dz = \int_{C_2}f\,dz$. Contours can be freely deformed through regions where $f$ is analytic, without changing the integral.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// VIZ 2: Contour deformation and singularity switch
// Domain-coloured background; bulge slider morphs contour from excluding to including origin;
// integral readout jumps from 0 to 2πi; winding number counter; optional second singularity.
{
  const W = 360, H = 320, SCALE = 70, CX = W / 2, CY = H / 2;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const STEPS = 360;

  const bulgeSlider = Inputs.range([-1.5, 1.5], { value: -0.8, step: 0.025, label: "Bulge (−: exclude origin, +: include)" });
  const secondSing = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Add second singularity at z = 1.5", value: false });

  function toSx(re) { return CX + re * SCALE; }
  function toSy(im) { return CY - im * SCALE; }

  // Deformable contour C2: base circle of radius 1.8, bulged toward/away from origin
  // bulge > 0 means the contour bows inward toward origin, eventually enclosing it
  function contourC2(theta, bulge) {
    // Offset the radius at each angle: bulge shifts the leftmost point
    // r(theta) = 1.8 + bulge * cos(theta)  (max deformation along Re axis)
    const r = 1.8 + bulge * Math.cos(theta);
    return [r * Math.cos(theta), r * Math.sin(theta)];
  }

  function pointInContour(px, py, bulge) {
    // Ray-casting: count crossings from (px,py) in +x direction
    let crossings = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < STEPS; k++) {
      const t0 = (2 * Math.PI * k) / STEPS;
      const t1 = (2 * Math.PI * (k + 1)) / STEPS;
      const [x0, y0] = contourC2(t0, bulge);
      const [x1, y1] = contourC2(t1, bulge);
      if ((y0 <= py && y1 > py) || (y1 <= py && y0 > py)) {
        const xIntersect = x0 + ((py - y0) / (y1 - y0)) * (x1 - x0);
        if (px < xIntersect) crossings++;
      }
    }
    return crossings % 2 === 1;
  }

  function computeC2Integral(bulge, singRe, singIm) {
    // ∮ 1/(z - sing) dz numerically
    let rSum = 0, iSum = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < STEPS; k++) {
      const t0 = (2 * Math.PI * k) / STEPS;
      const t1 = (2 * Math.PI * (k + 1)) / STEPS;
      const [r0, i0] = contourC2(t0, bulge);
      const [r1, i1] = contourC2(t1, bulge);
      const mr = (r0 + r1) / 2, mi = (i0 + i1) / 2;
      const dr = r1 - r0, di = i1 - i0;
      const denom = (mr - singRe) ** 2 + (mi - singIm) ** 2;
      if (denom < 1e-8) continue;
      const fr = (mr - singRe) / denom, fi = -(mi - singIm) / denom;
      rSum += fr * dr - fi * di;
      iSum += fi * dr + fr * di;
    }
    return [rSum, iSum];
  }

  function hslToRgb(h, s, l) {
    h = ((h % 1) + 1) % 1;
    const c = (1 - Math.abs(2 * l - 1)) * s;
    const x = c * (1 - Math.abs(((h * 6) % 2) - 1));
    const m = l - c / 2;
    let r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
    if (h < 1/6) { r = c; g = x; }
    else if (h < 2/6) { r = x; g = c; }
    else if (h < 3/6) { g = c; b = x; }
    else if (h < 4/6) { g = x; b = c; }
    else if (h < 5/6) { r = x; b = c; }
    else { r = c; b = x; }
    return [Math.round((r+m)*255), Math.round((g+m)*255), Math.round((b+m)*255)];
  }

  function render(bulge, showSecond) {
    // Canvas for domain colouring
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = W; canvas.height = H;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    const img = ctx.createImageData(W, H);
    const data = img.data;

    for (let px = 0; px < W; px++) {
      for (let py = 0; py < H; py++) {
        const re = (px - CX) / SCALE;
        const im = -(py - CY) / SCALE;
        // Colour by 1/z (primary singularity at origin)
        const d2 = re * re + im * im;
        let hue, brightness;
        if (d2 < 1e-6) {
          const idx = (py * W + px) * 4;
          data[idx] = 255; data[idx+1] = 255; data[idx+2] = 255; data[idx+3] = 255;
          continue;
        }
        const wr = re / d2, wi = -im / d2;
        const arg = Math.atan2(wi, wr);
        const mag = Math.sqrt(wr*wr + wi*wi);
        hue = (arg / (2 * Math.PI) + 1) % 1;
        brightness = 0.45 + 0.3 * Math.tanh(Math.log(mag + 0.001) / 2);
        const [r, g, b] = hslToRgb(hue, 0.72, brightness);
        const idx = (py * W + px) * 4;
        data[idx] = r; data[idx+1] = g; data[idx+2] = b; data[idx+3] = 255;
      }
    }
    ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);

    // Fixed outer circle C1 (orange)
    const [ox, oy] = [toSx(0), toSy(0)];
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#f97316"; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ox, oy, 2.5 * SCALE, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f97316"; ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("C\u2081 (fixed)", toSx(2.5) + 4, toSy(0));

    // Deformable contour C2 (blue)
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#3b82f6"; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let k = 0; k <= STEPS; k++) {
      const theta = (2 * Math.PI * k) / STEPS;
      const [cr, ci] = contourC2(theta, bulge);
      const sx = toSx(cr), sy = toSy(ci);
      k === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(sx, sy) : ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
    }
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3b82f6"; ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("C\u2082 (deformable)", toSx(-2.4), toSy(1.2));

    // Origin singularity ×
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff"; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ox-7, oy-7); ctx.lineTo(ox+7, oy+7); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ox+7, oy-7); ctx.lineTo(ox-7, oy+7); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff"; ctx.font = "9px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("1/z", ox+10, oy-5);

    // Second singularity at z=1.5
    if (showSecond) {
      const [sx2, sy2] = [toSx(1.5), toSy(0)];
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#dc2626"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx2-6, sy2-6); ctx.lineTo(sx2+6, sy2+6); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx2+6, sy2-6); ctx.lineTo(sx2-6, sy2+6); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#dc2626"; ctx.font = "9px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("1/(z-1.5)", sx2+8, sy2-4);
    }

    // Winding number box for C2 around origin
    const originInC2 = pointInContour(0, 0, bulge);
    const winding2 = originInC2 ? 1 : 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1e40af";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(W - 92, 5, 86, 44, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "white"; ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "10px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("n(C\u2082, 0)", W - 49, 21);
    ctx.font = "bold 18px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(winding2.toString(), W - 49, 41);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";

    return { canvas, originInC2, winding2 };
  }

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0; font-family:sans-serif;";

  const title = document.createElement("div");
  title.style.cssText = "font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem;";
  title.textContent = "Contour deformation: deforming C\u2082 past the singularity";
  container.appendChild(title);

  container.appendChild(bulgeSlider);
  container.appendChild(secondSing);

  const canvasDiv = document.createElement("div");
  container.appendChild(canvasDiv);

  const readout = document.createElement("div");
  readout.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.88em; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:0.5rem;";
  container.appendChild(readout);

  const noteEl = document.createElement("div");
  noteEl.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  noteEl.textContent = "Drag the bulge slider left to exclude the origin (integral = 0) and right to enclose it (integral = 2\u03c0i). The fixed outer circle C\u2081 always encloses the singularity; C\u2082 starts outside and crosses through. Toggle the second singularity at z = 1.5 to see its separate contribution.";
  container.appendChild(noteEl);

  function update() {
    const bulge = bulgeSlider.value;
    const showSecond = secondSing.value;
    const { canvas, originInC2 } = render(bulge, showSecond);
    canvasDiv.innerHTML = ""; canvasDiv.appendChild(canvas);

    // Compute integrals
    const [c2Re, c2Im] = computeC2Integral(bulge, 0, 0);
    const c1Im = 2 * Math.PI; // always encloses origin
    let html = `<div style="background:#fff7ed; border:1px solid #fed7aa; border-radius:4px; padding:0.4rem 0.6rem;">
      <span style="color:#f97316; font-weight:600;">C\u2081:</span>
      \u222e 1/z dz = 0 + ${c1Im.toFixed(4)}i = 2\u03c0i</div>`;
    const c2Status = originInC2
      ? `<span style="color:#059669; font-weight:600;">C\u2082 encloses origin \u2192 2\u03c0i</span>`
      : `<span style="color:#6b7280; font-weight:600;">C\u2082 excludes origin \u2192 0</span>`;
    html += `<div style="background:#eff6ff; border:1px solid #bfdbfe; border-radius:4px; padding:0.4rem 0.6rem;">
      <span style="color:#3b82f6; font-weight:600;">C\u2082:</span>
      \u222e 1/z dz \u2248 ${c2Re.toFixed(3)} + ${c2Im.toFixed(3)}i &nbsp; ${c2Status}</div>`;

    if (showSecond) {
      const [s2Re, s2Im] = computeC2Integral(bulge, 1.5, 0);
      html += `<div style="background:#fef2f2; border:1px solid #fecaca; border-radius:4px; padding:0.4rem 0.6rem; grid-column:1/-1;">
        <span style="color:#dc2626; font-weight:600;">C\u2082 around 1/(z-1.5):</span>
        \u222e 1/(z-1.5) dz \u2248 ${s2Re.toFixed(3)} + ${s2Im.toFixed(3)}i
        &nbsp; ${pointInContour(1.5, 0, bulge)
          ? '<span style="color:#059669; font-weight:600;">enclosed \u2192 2\u03c0i</span>'
          : '<span style="color:#6b7280; font-weight:600;">not enclosed \u2192 0</span>'}</div>`;
    }
    readout.innerHTML = html;
  }
  bulgeSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  secondSing.addEventListener("input", update);
  update();

  return container;
}
```

---

## Cauchy's integral formula

**Cauchy's integral formula.** Let $f$ be analytic in and on a simple closed contour $C$ (traversed counterclockwise). Then for any $z_0$ interior to $C$:

$$f(z_0) = \frac{1}{2\pi i}\oint_C \frac{f(z)}{z - z_0}\,dz$$

Equivalently:

$$\oint_C \frac{f(z)}{z - z_0}\,dz = 2\pi i\,f(z_0)$$

*Proof sketch.* Because $f$ is analytic everywhere inside $C$ except at $z_0$, the deformation principle applies to the annular region between $C$ and any circle around $z_0$: the integrand $f(z)/(z-z_0)$ is analytic there. Shrink $C$ to a small circle $C_\varepsilon$ of radius $\varepsilon$ around $z_0$ without changing the integral. As $\varepsilon \to 0$, $f(z) \to f(z_0)$ uniformly on $C_\varepsilon$, and $\oint_{C_\varepsilon} dz/(z-z_0) = 2\pi i$.

**Significance.** The value of an analytic function at any interior point is completely determined by its values on the boundary. This has no analogue in real analysis.

### Derivatives of all orders

Differentiating the integral formula with respect to $z_0$ under the integral sign (valid because $f$ is analytic and the denominator never vanishes on $C$):

$$f^{(n)}(z_0) = \frac{n!}{2\pi i}\oint_C \frac{f(z)}{(z-z_0)^{n+1}}\,dz$$

Rearranged to evaluate a given integral: $\displaystyle\oint_C \frac{f(z)}{(z-z_0)^{n+1}}\,dz = \frac{2\pi i}{n!}\,f^{(n)}(z_0)$.

**Consequence.** An analytic function has derivatives of all orders, all of which are themselves analytic. In real analysis, once-differentiable functions need not be twice differentiable. In complex analysis, once differentiable means infinitely differentiable — a qualitative difference.

---

## Major consequences

### Liouville's theorem

A **bounded** entire function is constant. (An *entire* function is one that is analytic everywhere in $\mathbb{C}$ — no singularities at all.)

*Proof.* If $|f(z)| \leq M$ everywhere, the ML inequality applied to the derivative formula gives $|f'(z_0)| \leq M/R$ for any circle of radius $R$. Letting $R \to \infty$ gives $f'(z_0) = 0$.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// VIZ 7: Liouville's theorem — collapsing bound
// Growing circle of radius R; M/R curve collapsing toward zero;
// candidate |f'| line contradicted as R grows.
{
  const W = 400, H = 220;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  const RSlider = Inputs.range([0.1, 30], { value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Radius R" });
  const MSlider = Inputs.range([0.1, 10], { value: 2, step: 0.1, label: "Bound M (|f| \u2264 M)" });
  const fpSlider = Inputs.range([0, 3], { value: 0.5, step: 0.01, label: "Candidate |f\u2032(z\u2080)|" });

  function build(R, M, fp) {
    const PLOTW = W - 60, PLOTH = H - 40;
    const PX = 45, PY = 10;
    const RMax = 30;

    const svg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width", W); svg.setAttribute("height", H);
    svg.style.cssText = "background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";

    // Axes
    const axH = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    axH.setAttribute("x1", PX); axH.setAttribute("y1", PY + PLOTH);
    axH.setAttribute("x2", PX + PLOTW); axH.setAttribute("y2", PY + PLOTH);
    axH.setAttribute("stroke", "#9ca3af"); axH.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.5");
    svg.appendChild(axH);
    const axV = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    axV.setAttribute("x1", PX); axV.setAttribute("y1", PY);
    axV.setAttribute("x2", PX); axV.setAttribute("y2", PY + PLOTH);
    axV.setAttribute("stroke", "#9ca3af"); axV.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.5");
    svg.appendChild(axV);

    // Axis labels
    const xlbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    xlbl.setAttribute("x", PX + PLOTW - 4); xlbl.setAttribute("y", PY + PLOTH + 14);
    xlbl.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); xlbl.setAttribute("fill", "#6b7280");
    xlbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); xlbl.textContent = "R";
    svg.appendChild(xlbl);
    const ylbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    ylbl.setAttribute("x", 2); ylbl.setAttribute("y", PY + 6);
    ylbl.setAttribute("font-size", "9"); ylbl.setAttribute("fill", "#6b7280");
    ylbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); ylbl.textContent = "M/R";
    svg.appendChild(ylbl);

    function toX(r) { return PX + (r / RMax) * PLOTW; }
    function toY(v) {
      const Mmax = M * 10;
      return PY + PLOTH - Math.min(PLOTH * 0.95, (v / Mmax) * PLOTH);
    }

    // M/R decay curve
    let curvD = "";
    for (let k = 1; k <= 200; k++) {
      const r = (RMax * k) / 200;
      curvD += (k === 1 ? "M" : "L") + ` ${toX(r)} ${toY(M / r)}`;
    }
    const curvEl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "path");
    curvEl.setAttribute("d", curvD); curvEl.setAttribute("fill", "none");
    curvEl.setAttribute("stroke", "#3b82f6"); curvEl.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
    svg.appendChild(curvEl);

    // Horizontal line for candidate |f'(z₀)|
    const fpY = toY(fp);
    const fpLine = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    fpLine.setAttribute("x1", PX); fpLine.setAttribute("y1", fpY);
    fpLine.setAttribute("x2", PX + PLOTW); fpLine.setAttribute("y2", fpY);
    fpLine.setAttribute("stroke", "#f97316"); fpLine.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.5");
    fpLine.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", "5,3");
    svg.appendChild(fpLine);
    const fpLbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    fpLbl.setAttribute("x", PX + PLOTW + 2); fpLbl.setAttribute("y", fpY + 4);
    fpLbl.setAttribute("font-size", "9"); fpLbl.setAttribute("fill", "#f97316");
    fpLbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); fpLbl.textContent = "|f\u2032| = " + fp.toFixed(2);
    svg.appendChild(fpLbl);

    // Current R marker on curve
    const curY = toY(M / R);
    const curDot = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "circle");
    curDot.setAttribute("cx", toX(R)); curDot.setAttribute("cy", curY);
    curDot.setAttribute("r", "5"); curDot.setAttribute("fill", "#3b82f6");
    curDot.setAttribute("stroke", "#fff"); curDot.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.5");
    svg.appendChild(curDot);

    // Bound value label
    const boundVal = M / R;
    const boundLbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    boundLbl.setAttribute("x", toX(R) + 6); boundLbl.setAttribute("y", curY - 4);
    boundLbl.setAttribute("font-size", "9"); boundLbl.setAttribute("fill", "#3b82f6");
    boundLbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif");
    boundLbl.textContent = "M/R = " + boundVal.toFixed(3);
    svg.appendChild(boundLbl);

    // Contradiction indicator
    const contradicted = fp > M / R;
    const annot = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    annot.setAttribute("x", W / 2); annot.setAttribute("y", H - 6);
    annot.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); annot.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    annot.setAttribute("font-weight", "bold"); annot.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif");
    annot.setAttribute("fill", contradicted ? "#dc2626" : "#059669");
    annot.textContent = contradicted
      ? "|f\u2032| > M/R \u2014 impossible! As R\u2192\u221e, bound \u21920, so |f\u2032| must be 0"
      : "|f\u2032| \u2264 M/R \u2014 consistent (increase R to force contradiction)";
    svg.appendChild(annot);

    return svg;
  }

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0; font-family:sans-serif;";

  const titleEl = document.createElement("div");
  titleEl.style.cssText = "font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem;";
  titleEl.textContent = "Liouville\u2019s theorem: the M/R bound collapses to zero";
  container.appendChild(titleEl);
  container.appendChild(RSlider);
  container.appendChild(MSlider);
  container.appendChild(fpSlider);

  const vizDiv = document.createElement("div");
  vizDiv.style.marginTop = "0.5rem";
  container.appendChild(vizDiv);

  const noteEl = document.createElement("div");
  noteEl.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  noteEl.textContent = "The blue curve M/R falls toward zero as R grows. Any non-zero candidate |f\u2032(z\u2080)| (orange dashed line) will eventually exceed the bound \u2014 a contradiction. Therefore f\u2032 = 0, and f is constant.";
  container.appendChild(noteEl);

  function update() {
    vizDiv.innerHTML = "";
    vizDiv.appendChild(build(RSlider.value, MSlider.value, fpSlider.value));
  }
  RSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  MSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  fpSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  update();

  return container;
}
```

### Fundamental theorem of algebra

Every non-constant polynomial $p(z)$ of degree $n \geq 1$ has exactly $n$ complex roots (counting multiplicity).

*Proof sketch.* If $p$ had no roots, $1/p(z)$ would be entire (no zeros means no poles) and bounded (since $|p(z)| \to \infty$ as $|z| \to \infty$, so $|1/p(z)| \to 0$), contradicting Liouville's theorem.

### Morera's theorem

If $f$ is continuous on a domain $D$ and $\oint_C f\,dz = 0$ for every closed triangle $C$ in $D$, then $f$ is analytic in $D$. (The converse of Cauchy's theorem.)

---

## Application: real integrals via contour integration

The general strategy — closing a real integral with a contour in the complex plane and applying Cauchy's theorem — is developed fully in the next chapter. This example shows the technique in its simplest form.

**Example.** $\displaystyle\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \frac{dx}{1+x^2}$.

The integrand $f(z) = 1/(1+z^2)$ has poles at $z = \pm i$. Close the real-line integral with a large semicircle $\Gamma_R$ of radius $R$ in the upper half-plane, forming a closed contour $C = [-R,R] + \Gamma_R$.

**The semicircle contribution vanishes.** On $\Gamma_R$, $|z| = R$, so $|1+z^2| \geq R^2 - 1$ for large $R$. The ML inequality gives:
$$\left|\int_{\Gamma_R}\frac{dz}{1+z^2}\right| \leq \frac{1}{R^2-1}\cdot \pi R \to 0 \quad\text{as } R\to\infty$$

**Applying Cauchy's integral formula.** Factor the denominator: $1/(1+z^2) = [1/(z+i)]/(z-i)$. This has the form $f(z)/(z-z_0)$ with $f(z) = 1/(z+i)$ and $z_0 = i$. Since $z_0 = i$ lies inside the upper half-plane contour and $f(z) = 1/(z+i)$ is analytic there:

$$\oint_C \frac{dz}{1+z^2} = \oint_C \frac{dz}{(z-i)(z+i)} = 2\pi i \cdot f(i) = 2\pi i \cdot \frac{1}{2i} = \pi$$

Since the semicircle contributes nothing, the real-line integral equals $\pi$ — confirming the known result $\arctan(x)\big|_{-\infty}^{\infty} = \pi$.

::: {.callout-note}
This calculation uses Cauchy's integral formula because the integrand has a single simple pole and a purely analytic numerator. In engineering practice, the same closing-contour technique is applied via the **residue theorem** (Chapter 3), which handles poles of any order and multiple singularities simultaneously. The present example is the simplest special case of that general method.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// VIZ 3: Cauchy integral formula — draggable pole
// Domain-coloured canvas; drag z₀ freely; smooth crossing triggers integral jump;
// KaTeX formula display; "pole on contour" warning; winding number box.
{
  const W = 360, H = 320, SCALE = 72, CX = W / 2, CY = H / 2;
  const STEPS = 360;

  const radiusCIF = Inputs.range([0.5, 2.8], { value: 1.5, step: 0.05, label: "Contour radius R" });
  const funcCIF = Inputs.select(
    ["f(z) = e^z", "f(z) = cos z", "f(z) = 1/(z+2)"],
    { value: "f(z) = e^z", label: "f(z) (numerator)" }
  );

  // Mutable pole position — shared via a plain object so canvas listeners can mutate it
  const pole = { re: 0.6, im: 0.4 };

  function evalFCIF(fname, re, im) {
    if (fname === "f(z) = e^z") return [Math.exp(re) * Math.cos(im), Math.exp(re) * Math.sin(im)];
    if (fname === "f(z) = cos z") return [Math.cos(re) * Math.cosh(im), -Math.sin(re) * Math.sinh(im)];
    const dr = re + 2, di = im, d = dr * dr + di * di;
    if (d < 1e-10) return [0, 0];
    return [dr / d, -di / d];
  }

  function hslRgbCIF(h, s, l) {
    h = ((h % 1) + 1) % 1;
    const c = (1 - Math.abs(2 * l - 1)) * s;
    const x = c * (1 - Math.abs(((h * 6) % 2) - 1));
    const m = l - c / 2;
    let r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
    if (h < 1/6) { r = c; g = x; }
    else if (h < 2/6) { r = x; g = c; }
    else if (h < 3/6) { g = c; b = x; }
    else if (h < 4/6) { g = x; b = c; }
    else if (h < 5/6) { r = x; b = c; }
    else { r = c; b = x; }
    return [Math.round((r+m)*255), Math.round((g+m)*255), Math.round((b+m)*255)];
  }

  function toSxCIF(re) { return CX + re * SCALE; }
  function toSyCIF(im) { return CY - im * SCALE; }
  function fromSxCIF(px) { return (px - CX) / SCALE; }
  function fromSyCIF(py) { return -(py - CY) / SCALE; }

  function drawCIF(canvas, R, fname) {
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    const img = ctx.createImageData(W, H);
    const data = img.data;
    const z0re = pole.re, z0im = pole.im;

    for (let px = 0; px < W; px++) {
      for (let py = 0; py < H; py++) {
        const re = fromSxCIF(px), im = fromSyCIF(py);
        const dr = re - z0re, di = im - z0im;
        const d2 = dr * dr + di * di;
        if (d2 < 4e-4) {
          const idx = (py * W + px) * 4;
          data[idx] = 255; data[idx+1] = 255; data[idx+2] = 255; data[idx+3] = 255;
          continue;
        }
        const wr = dr / d2, wi = -di / d2;
        const arg = Math.atan2(wi, wr);
        const mag = Math.sqrt(wr*wr + wi*wi);
        const hue = (arg / (2 * Math.PI) + 1) % 1;
        const brightness = 0.48 + 0.32 * Math.tanh(Math.log(mag + 0.001) / 2);
        const [r, g, b] = hslRgbCIF(hue, 0.75, brightness);
        const idx = (py * W + px) * 4;
        data[idx] = r; data[idx+1] = g; data[idx+2] = b; data[idx+3] = 255;
      }
    }
    ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);

    const dist = Math.sqrt(z0re * z0re + z0im * z0im);
    const onContour = Math.abs(dist - R) < 0.12;
    const inside = dist < R && !onContour;

    // Contour circle
    const ox = toSxCIF(0), oy = toSyCIF(0);
    ctx.strokeStyle = onContour ? "#dc2626" : "#ffffff";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ox, oy, R * SCALE, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)"; ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("C: |z| = " + R.toFixed(2), 6, 16);

    // Pole marker ×
    const px0 = toSxCIF(z0re), py0 = toSyCIF(z0im);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px0-8, py0-8); ctx.lineTo(px0+8, py0+8); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px0+8, py0-8); ctx.lineTo(px0-8, py0+8); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)"; ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("z\u2080 = " + z0re.toFixed(2) + (z0im >= 0 ? "+" : "") + z0im.toFixed(2) + "i", px0 + 11, py0 + 4);

    // Winding number box
    const winding = inside ? 1 : 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1e40af";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(W - 92, 5, 86, 44, 5); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "white"; ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "10px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("n(C, z\u2080)", W - 49, 21);
    ctx.font = "bold 18px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText(winding.toString(), W - 49, 41);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";

    return { inside, onContour };
  }

  // Build the container with canvas + info panel
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0; font-family:sans-serif;";

  const titleEl = document.createElement("div");
  titleEl.style.cssText = "font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem;";
  titleEl.textContent = "Cauchy integral formula: drag the pole z\u2080";
  container.appendChild(titleEl);

  container.appendChild(radiusCIF);
  container.appendChild(funcCIF);

  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = W; canvas.height = H;
  canvas.style.cssText = "display:block; cursor:crosshair; border-radius:6px; margin-top:0.5rem;";
  container.appendChild(canvas);

  const infoDiv = document.createElement("div");
  infoDiv.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.88em;";
  container.appendChild(infoDiv);

  const noteEl = document.createElement("div");
  noteEl.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  noteEl.textContent = "Click or drag anywhere on the canvas to move z\u2080. The domain colouring shows 1/(z\u2212z\u2080): the pole blooms white. Crossing the contour boundary instantly changes the integral from 0 to 2\u03c0i\u00b7f(z\u2080). When z\u2080 lands on C itself, the integral is undefined.";
  container.appendChild(noteEl);

  function updateCIF() {
    const R = radiusCIF.value;
    const fname = funcCIF.value;
    const { inside, onContour } = drawCIF(canvas, R, fname);
    const z0re = pole.re, z0im = pole.im;

    if (onContour) {
      infoDiv.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#dc2626; font-weight:600; padding:0.4rem 0.6rem; background:#fef2f2; border-radius:4px;">
        Pole on contour C \u2014 integral is undefined (integrand blows up on the path)</div>`;
    } else if (inside) {
      const [fre, fim] = evalFCIF(fname, z0re, z0im);
      const resRe = (-2 * Math.PI * fim).toFixed(4);
      const resIm = (2 * Math.PI * fre).toFixed(4);
      infoDiv.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:0.4rem 0.6rem; background:#f0fdf4; border:1px solid #bbf7d0; border-radius:4px;">
        <span style="color:#059669; font-weight:600;">z\u2080 inside C \u2014 Cauchy formula applies</span><br>
        f(z\u2080) = ${fre.toFixed(4)} + ${fim.toFixed(4)}i<br>
        <strong>\u222e f(z)/(z\u2212z\u2080) dz = 2\u03c0i \u00b7 f(z\u2080) = ${resRe} + ${resIm}i</strong></div>`;
    } else {
      infoDiv.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:0.4rem 0.6rem; background:#f9fafb; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:4px;">
        <span style="color:#6b7280; font-weight:600;">z\u2080 outside C \u2014 integrand is analytic inside</span><br>
        Cauchy\u2013Goursat theorem: <strong>\u222e f(z)/(z\u2212z\u2080) dz = 0</strong></div>`;
    }
  }

  // Drag handling on canvas
  let dragging = false;
  function movePole(evt) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const scaleX = W / rect.width, scaleY = H / rect.height;
    const cpx = (evt.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
    const cpy = (evt.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY;
    pole.re = Math.max(-3.5, Math.min(3.5, fromSxCIF(cpx)));
    pole.im = Math.max(-3.5, Math.min(3.5, fromSyCIF(cpy)));
    updateCIF();
  }
  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => { dragging = true; movePole(e); });
  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => { if (dragging) movePole(e); });
  canvas.addEventListener("mouseup", () => { dragging = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { dragging = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); dragging = true; movePole(e.touches[0]); }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (dragging) movePole(e.touches[0]); }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchend", () => { dragging = false; });

  radiusCIF.addEventListener("input", updateCIF);
  funcCIF.addEventListener("input", updateCIF);
  updateCIF();

  return container;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const W = 420, H = 380, CX = 190, CY = 185, SCALE = 65;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  const pathSelector2 = Inputs.select([
    "Circle around origin (n=1)",
    "Circle not around origin (n=0)",
    "Two loops around origin (n=2)"
  ], {value: "Circle around origin (n=1)", label: "Path"});

  const tSlider2 = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.005, label: "Progress t"});

  const pathDefs = {
    "Circle around origin (n=1)": {
      pts: (t) => [1.5*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*t), 1.5*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*t)],
      nWinding: 1
    },
    "Circle not around origin (n=0)": {
      pts: (t) => [1.8 + 0.8*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*t), 0.8*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*t)],
      nWinding: 0
    },
    "Two loops around origin (n=2)": {
      pts: (t) => [1.5*Math.cos(4*Math.PI*t), 1.5*Math.sin(4*Math.PI*t)],
      nWinding: 2
    }
  };

  function getPathPoint(def, t) { return def.pts(t); }

  function computeIntegral(def, upToT, STEPS) {
    // Numerically integrate dz/z from 0 to upToT
    // Result is a complex number (Re, Im)
    let sumRe = 0, sumIm = 0;
    const steps = Math.round(upToT * STEPS);
    const dt = upToT / Math.max(steps, 1);

    for (let s=0; s<steps; s++) {
      const t = s / STEPS;
      const tn = (s+1) / STEPS;
      const [re1, im1] = def.pts(t);
      const [re2, im2] = def.pts(tn < 1 ? tn : 1);
      // midpoint
      const mre = (re1+re2)/2, mim = (im1+im2)/2;
      const dre = re2-re1, dim = im2-im1;
      const dz_over_z_re = (mre*dre + mim*dim)/(mre*mre+mim*mim);
      const dz_over_z_im = (mim*dre - mre*dim)/(mre*mre+mim*mim);
      sumRe += dz_over_z_re;
      sumIm += dz_over_z_im;
    }
    return [sumRe, sumIm];
  }

  function toScreen(re, im) { return [CX + re*SCALE, CY - im*SCALE]; }

  function render2(pathName, tVal) {
    const def = pathDefs[pathName];
    const STEPS = 400;

    const svg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width", W); svg.setAttribute("height", H);
    svg.style.cssText = "background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";

    // Grid + axes
    const gridG = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"g");
    gridG.setAttribute("stroke","#e5e7eb"); gridG.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.5");
    for (let i=-3; i<=3; i++) {
      const xl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line"); const [lx]=toScreen(i,0); const [,ly1]=toScreen(0,-2.6); const [,ly2]=toScreen(0,2.6);
      xl.setAttribute("x1",lx); xl.setAttribute("y1",ly1); xl.setAttribute("x2",lx); xl.setAttribute("y2",ly2); gridG.appendChild(xl);
      const yl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line"); const [lx1]=toScreen(-3,0); const [lx2]=toScreen(3,0); const [,ly]=toScreen(0,i);
      yl.setAttribute("x1",lx1); yl.setAttribute("y1",ly); yl.setAttribute("x2",lx2); yl.setAttribute("y2",ly); gridG.appendChild(yl);
    }
    svg.appendChild(gridG);

    const [ox,oy]=toScreen(0,0);
    const axG=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"g"); axG.setAttribute("stroke","#9ca3af"); axG.setAttribute("stroke-width","1");
    const xa=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line"); const [ax1]=toScreen(-2.8,0); const [ax2]=toScreen(2.8,0);
    xa.setAttribute("x1",ax1); xa.setAttribute("y1",oy); xa.setAttribute("x2",ax2); xa.setAttribute("y2",oy);
    const ya=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line"); const [,ay1]=toScreen(0,-2.5); const [,ay2]=toScreen(0,2.5);
    ya.setAttribute("x1",ox); ya.setAttribute("y1",ay1); ya.setAttribute("x2",ox); ya.setAttribute("y2",ay2);
    axG.appendChild(xa); axG.appendChild(ya); svg.appendChild(axG);

    // Full path outline
    let pathD = "";
    for (let s=0; s<=STEPS; s++) {
      const t = s/STEPS;
      const [re,im] = def.pts(t);
      const [px,py] = toScreen(re,im);
      pathD += (s===0 ? `M ${px} ${py}` : ` L ${px} ${py}`);
    }
    const pathOutline = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"path");
    pathOutline.setAttribute("d",pathD); pathOutline.setAttribute("fill","none");
    pathOutline.setAttribute("stroke","rgba(249,115,22,0.25)"); pathOutline.setAttribute("stroke-width","2");
    svg.appendChild(pathOutline);

    // Traced portion
    let traceD = "";
    const traceSteps = Math.round(tVal * STEPS);
    for (let s=0; s<=traceSteps; s++) {
      const t = s/STEPS;
      const [re,im] = def.pts(t);
      const [px,py] = toScreen(re,im);
      traceD += (s===0 ? `M ${px} ${py}` : ` L ${px} ${py}`);
    }
    const traceEl = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"path");
    traceEl.setAttribute("d",traceD); traceEl.setAttribute("fill","none");
    traceEl.setAttribute("stroke","#f97316"); traceEl.setAttribute("stroke-width","2.5");
    svg.appendChild(traceEl);

    // Current point
    const [cre,cim] = def.pts(tVal);
    const [cpx,cpy] = toScreen(cre,cim);
    const ptEl = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"circle");
    ptEl.setAttribute("cx",cpx); ptEl.setAttribute("cy",cpy); ptEl.setAttribute("r","6");
    ptEl.setAttribute("fill","#3b82f6"); ptEl.setAttribute("stroke","#fff"); ptEl.setAttribute("stroke-width","2");
    svg.appendChild(ptEl);

    // Origin × mark (the singularity 1/z)
    const xSize = 5;
    const x1m=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line"); x1m.setAttribute("x1",ox-xSize); x1m.setAttribute("y1",oy-xSize);
    x1m.setAttribute("x2",ox+xSize); x1m.setAttribute("y2",oy+xSize);
    x1m.setAttribute("stroke","#ef4444"); x1m.setAttribute("stroke-width","2.5"); svg.appendChild(x1m);
    const x2m=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line"); x2m.setAttribute("x1",ox+xSize); x2m.setAttribute("y1",oy-xSize);
    x2m.setAttribute("x2",ox-xSize); x2m.setAttribute("y2",oy+xSize);
    x2m.setAttribute("stroke","#ef4444"); x2m.setAttribute("stroke-width","2.5"); svg.appendChild(x2m);
    const origLbl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text"); origLbl.setAttribute("x",ox+8); origLbl.setAttribute("y",oy-6);
    origLbl.setAttribute("fill","#ef4444"); origLbl.setAttribute("font-size","10"); origLbl.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");
    origLbl.textContent="singularity of 1/z"; svg.appendChild(origLbl);

    // Winding box
    const windBox = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"rect"); windBox.setAttribute("x",W-92); windBox.setAttribute("y",5);
    windBox.setAttribute("width",85); windBox.setAttribute("height",44); windBox.setAttribute("fill","#1e40af"); windBox.setAttribute("rx","5");
    svg.appendChild(windBox);
    const wl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text"); wl.setAttribute("x",W-49); wl.setAttribute("y",22);
    wl.setAttribute("fill","white"); wl.setAttribute("font-size","10"); wl.setAttribute("text-anchor","middle"); wl.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");
    wl.textContent="winding n"; svg.appendChild(wl);
    const wn=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text"); wn.setAttribute("x",W-49); wn.setAttribute("y",41);
    wn.setAttribute("fill","white"); wn.setAttribute("font-size","18"); wn.setAttribute("text-anchor","middle");
    wn.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif"); wn.setAttribute("font-weight","bold");
    // Running winding estimate: Im part of integral / 2π, rounded to 1 dp
    const [intReW, intImW] = computeIntegral(def, tVal, STEPS);
    const windEst = tVal > 0.02 ? (intImW / (2 * Math.PI)).toFixed(1) : "0.0";
    wn.textContent = tVal > 0.98 ? def.nWinding.toString() : windEst;
    svg.appendChild(wn);

    // Integral running display — always live from start
    const [intRe, intIm] = [intReW, intImW];
    const finalIntIm = 2*Math.PI*def.nWinding;

    const intDiv = document.createElement("div");
    intDiv.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-family:sans-serif; font-size:0.88em; padding:0.5rem; background:#f0f9ff; border-radius:4px;";
    // Show running value at all t; highlight final result when closed
    const runStr = `${intRe.toFixed(3)} + ${intIm.toFixed(3)}i`;
    const finalStr = tVal > 0.98
      ? ` \u2192 <strong>2\u03c0i \u00d7 ${def.nWinding} = ${finalIntIm.toFixed(3)}i</strong>` : "";
    intDiv.innerHTML = `<strong>Running \u222b dz/z:</strong> <span style="color:#1e40af">${runStr}${finalStr}</span>`;

    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.appendChild(svg);
    wrap.appendChild(intDiv);
    return wrap;
  }

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0;";
  const title = document.createElement("div");
  title.style.cssText = "font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem; font-family:sans-serif;";
  title.textContent = "Winding number = contour integral: \u222e dz/z = 2\u03c0i \xd7 n";
  container.appendChild(title);
  container.appendChild(pathSelector2);
  container.appendChild(tSlider2);

  const vizDiv2 = document.createElement("div");
  container.appendChild(vizDiv2);

  const note = document.createElement("div");
  note.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  note.textContent = "Move the slider to trace the path. When the loop closes: \u222e dz/z = 2\u03c0i times the winding number. The red \u00d7 marks the singularity at the origin. This is the seed from which the residue theorem grows.";
  container.appendChild(note);

  function update2() {
    vizDiv2.innerHTML = "";
    vizDiv2.appendChild(render2(pathSelector2.value, tSlider2.value));
  }
  pathSelector2.addEventListener("input", update2);
  tSlider2.addEventListener("input", update2);
  update2();

  return container;
}
```
