//| echo: false
// VIZ 8: Semicircle contour closure for 1/(1+x²)
// Real axis + growing semicircle; poles as × marks; residue sum updating;
// ML arc-bound overlay; result box for ∫ 1/(1+x²) dx = π.
{
  const W = 380, H = 280, SCALE = 55, OX = W / 2, OY = H - 50;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const STEPS = 200;

  const RscSlider = Inputs.range([0.5, 4.5], { value: 1.8, step: 0.05, label: "Semicircle radius R" });

  function toSx(re) { return OX + re * SCALE; }
  function toSy(im) { return OY - im * SCALE; }

  function buildSC(R) {
    const svg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width", W); svg.setAttribute("height", H);
    svg.style.cssText = "background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";

    // Real axis
    const ax = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    ax.setAttribute("x1", toSx(-4.2)); ax.setAttribute("y1", toSy(0));
    ax.setAttribute("x2", toSx(4.2)); ax.setAttribute("y2", toSy(0));
    ax.setAttribute("stroke", "#9ca3af"); ax.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.5");
    svg.appendChild(ax);
    const ay = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    ay.setAttribute("x1", toSx(0)); ay.setAttribute("y1", toSy(-0.3));
    ay.setAttribute("x2", toSx(0)); ay.setAttribute("y2", toSy(3.8));
    ay.setAttribute("stroke", "#9ca3af"); ay.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.5");
    svg.appendChild(ay);

    // Axis labels
    for (const v of [-3,-2,-1,1,2,3]) {
      const tl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
      tl.setAttribute("x", toSx(v) - 4); tl.setAttribute("y", toSy(0) + 14);
      tl.setAttribute("font-size", "9"); tl.setAttribute("fill", "#9ca3af");
      tl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); tl.textContent = v;
      svg.appendChild(tl);
    }
    const relbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    relbl.setAttribute("x", toSx(4.0)); relbl.setAttribute("y", toSy(0) - 4);
    relbl.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); relbl.setAttribute("fill", "#6b7280");
    relbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); relbl.textContent = "x";
    svg.appendChild(relbl);
    const imlbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    imlbl.setAttribute("x", toSx(0) + 4); imlbl.setAttribute("y", toSy(3.6));
    imlbl.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); imlbl.setAttribute("fill", "#6b7280");
    imlbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); imlbl.textContent = "iy";
    svg.appendChild(imlbl);

    // Real-axis segment [-R, R] (orange)
    const seg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    seg.setAttribute("x1", toSx(-R)); seg.setAttribute("y1", toSy(0));
    seg.setAttribute("x2", toSx(R)); seg.setAttribute("y2", toSy(0));
    seg.setAttribute("stroke", "#f97316"); seg.setAttribute("stroke-width", "3");
    svg.appendChild(seg);
    // Arrowhead at +R
    const arrowX = toSx(R), arrowY = toSy(0);
    const arrowM = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "polygon");
    arrowM.setAttribute("points", `${arrowX-8},${arrowY-4} ${arrowX},${arrowY} ${arrowX-8},${arrowY+4}`);
    arrowM.setAttribute("fill", "#f97316");
    svg.appendChild(arrowM);

    // Semicircle arc (blue), upper half-plane
    let arcD = `M ${toSx(R)} ${toSy(0)}`;
    for (let k = 1; k <= STEPS; k++) {
      const theta = (Math.PI * k) / STEPS;
      arcD += ` L ${toSx(R * Math.cos(theta))} ${toSy(R * Math.sin(theta))}`;
    }
    const arcEl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "path");
    arcEl.setAttribute("d", arcD); arcEl.setAttribute("fill", "none");
    arcEl.setAttribute("stroke", "#3b82f6"); arcEl.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2.5");
    svg.appendChild(arcEl);
    // Arc arrow at top
    const topX = toSx(0), topY = toSy(R);
    const arcArrow = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "polygon");
    arcArrow.setAttribute("points", `${topX-4},${topY+8} ${topX},${topY} ${topX+4},${topY+8}`);
    arcArrow.setAttribute("fill", "#3b82f6");
    svg.appendChild(arcArrow);

    // Poles of 1/(1+z²) = 1/((z-i)(z+i)): at z = i and z = -i
    const poles = [{ re: 0, im: 1, label: "z = i" }, { re: 0, im: -1, label: "z = \u2212i" }];
    for (const p of poles) {
      const px0 = toSx(p.re), py0 = toSy(p.im);
      const inContour = p.im > 0 && p.im < R; // upper half-plane, inside semicircle
      const xColor = inContour ? "#dc2626" : "#9ca3af";
      for (const [dx, dy] of [[6,6],[6,-6]]) {
        const xl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
        xl.setAttribute("x1", px0-dx); xl.setAttribute("y1", py0-dy);
        xl.setAttribute("x2", px0+dx); xl.setAttribute("y2", py0+dy);
        xl.setAttribute("stroke", xColor); xl.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2.5");
        svg.appendChild(xl);
      }
      const plbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
      plbl.setAttribute("x", px0 + 10); plbl.setAttribute("y", py0 + 4);
      plbl.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); plbl.setAttribute("fill", xColor);
      plbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); plbl.textContent = p.label;
      svg.appendChild(plbl);
    }

    // ML arc bound for semicircle contribution
    // |∫_arc 1/(1+z²) dz| ≤ M·πR where M = 1/(R²-1) for R>1
    const arcBound = R > 1.01 ? (1 / (R*R - 1)) * Math.PI * R : null;
    const poleInside = R > 1; // z=i is inside when R>1

    // Residue at z=i: 1/(z+i) at z=i = 1/(2i); residue × 2πi = 2πi × 1/(2i) = π
    const residueContrib = poleInside ? Math.PI : 0;

    // Info panel
    const infoX = 4, infoY = H - 45;
    const infoBg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "rect");
    infoBg.setAttribute("x", infoX); infoBg.setAttribute("y", infoY);
    infoBg.setAttribute("width", W - 8); infoBg.setAttribute("height", 40);
    infoBg.setAttribute("fill", poleInside ? "#f0fdf4" : "#f9fafb");
    infoBg.setAttribute("rx", "4");
    svg.appendChild(infoBg);

    const line1 = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    line1.setAttribute("x", infoX + 6); line1.setAttribute("y", infoY + 14);
    line1.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); line1.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif");
    line1.setAttribute("fill", poleInside ? "#059669" : "#6b7280");
    const arcBndStr = arcBound !== null ? "Arc bound: \u03c0R/(R\u00b2\u22121) \u2248 " + arcBound.toFixed(3) + " \u2192 0" : "R \u2264 1: pole not enclosed";
    line1.textContent = arcBndStr;
    svg.appendChild(line1);

    const line2 = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    line2.setAttribute("x", infoX + 6); line2.setAttribute("y", infoY + 30);
    line2.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); line2.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif");
    line2.setAttribute("font-weight", "600");
    line2.setAttribute("fill", poleInside ? "#059669" : "#6b7280");
    line2.textContent = poleInside
      ? "\u222b dx/(1+x\u00b2) = 2\u03c0i \u00d7 Res(i) = 2\u03c0i \u00d7 1/(2i) = \u03c0"
      : "z = i not yet inside \u2014 increase R above 1";
    svg.appendChild(line2);

    // R label
    const Rlbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    Rlbl.setAttribute("x", toSx(R) + 4); Rlbl.setAttribute("y", toSy(0) - 5);
    Rlbl.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); Rlbl.setAttribute("fill", "#f97316");
    Rlbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); Rlbl.textContent = "R = " + R.toFixed(2);
    svg.appendChild(Rlbl);
    const semicircLbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
    semicircLbl.setAttribute("x", toSx(0) - 14); semicircLbl.setAttribute("y", toSy(R) - 6);
    semicircLbl.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); semicircLbl.setAttribute("fill", "#3b82f6");
    semicircLbl.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif"); semicircLbl.textContent = "\u0393\u1d54";
    svg.appendChild(semicircLbl);

    return svg;
  }

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0; font-family:sans-serif;";

  const titleEl = document.createElement("div");
  titleEl.style.cssText = "font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem;";
  titleEl.textContent = "Semicircle closure: evaluating \u222b\u208b\u221e\u207a\u221e dx/(1+x\u00b2)";
  container.appendChild(titleEl);
  container.appendChild(RscSlider);

  const vizDiv = document.createElement("div");
  vizDiv.style.marginTop = "0.5rem";
  container.appendChild(vizDiv);

  const noteEl = document.createElement("div");
  noteEl.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  noteEl.textContent = "The orange segment is the real-axis part [\u2212R, R]; the blue arc is the semicircle \u0393\u1d54. The \u00d7 marks are poles of 1/(1+z\u00b2). Once R > 1, the pole z = i is captured (red). The ML bound on the arc contribution shrinks toward zero. The result \u03c0 appears in the green box.";
  container.appendChild(noteEl);

  function update() {
    vizDiv.innerHTML = "";
    vizDiv.appendChild(buildSC(RscSlider.value));
  }
  RscSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  update();

  return container;
}

## Exercises

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
katex = require("katex@0.16")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function makeStepperHTML(steps) {
  let current = 0;
  const totalSteps = steps.length;
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem 1.25rem; margin:0.75rem 0; font-family:inherit;";
  const stepsDiv = document.createElement("div");
  stepsDiv.style.marginBottom = "0.75rem";
  function renderSteps() {
    stepsDiv.innerHTML = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < current; i++) {
      const s = steps[i];
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.style.cssText = "display:grid; grid-template-columns:220px 1fr; gap:0.35rem 1rem; align-items:baseline; padding:0.35rem 0; border-top:1px solid #f3f4f6;";
      const opCell = document.createElement("span");
      opCell.style.cssText = "font-size:0.85em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
      opCell.textContent = s.op;
      const eqCell = document.createElement("span");
      eqCell.innerHTML = katex.renderToString(s.eq, { throwOnError: false, displayMode: false });
      row.appendChild(opCell); row.appendChild(eqCell);
      if (s.note) {
        const noteRow = document.createElement("div");
        noteRow.style.cssText = "grid-column:2; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; padding-bottom:0.2rem;";
        noteRow.textContent = s.note;
        row.appendChild(noteRow);
      }
      stepsDiv.appendChild(row);
    }
    if (current === totalSteps) {
      const done = document.createElement("div");
      done.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.9em; color:#059669; font-weight:500;";
      done.textContent = "Solution complete.";
      stepsDiv.appendChild(done);
    }
  }
  const controls = document.createElement("div");
  controls.style.cssText = "display:flex; gap:0.5rem; align-items:center;";
  const nextBtn = document.createElement("button");
  nextBtn.textContent = "Next step →";
  nextBtn.style.cssText = "padding:0.42rem 0.95rem; border:1px solid #2563eb; border-radius:5px; background:#2563eb; color:#ffffff; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.9em; font-weight:600; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(37,99,235,0.18);";
  const resetBtn = document.createElement("button");
  resetBtn.textContent = "Reset";
  resetBtn.style.cssText = "padding:0.42rem 0.8rem; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:5px; background:#f8fafc; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.9em; color:#475569; font-weight:500;";
  const counter = document.createElement("span");
  counter.style.cssText = "font-size:0.82em; color:#9ca3af; margin-left:0.25rem;";
  function updateButtons() {
    nextBtn.disabled = current === totalSteps;
    nextBtn.style.opacity = current === totalSteps ? "0.4" : "1";
    counter.textContent = current === 0 ? "Click to reveal steps" : `Step ${current} of ${totalSteps}`;
  }
  nextBtn.onclick = () => { if (current < totalSteps) { current++; renderSteps(); updateButtons(); } };
  resetBtn.onclick = () => { current = 0; renderSteps(); updateButtons(); };
  controls.appendChild(nextBtn); controls.appendChild(resetBtn); controls.appendChild(counter);
  container.appendChild(stepsDiv); container.appendChild(controls);
  renderSteps(); updateButtons();
  return container;
}
```

### Exercise 1: Direct computation of a contour integral

Compute $\displaystyle\int_C \bar{z}\,dz$ where $C$ is the straight line from $0$ to $1+i$.

<!-- STEPPER -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
makeStepperHTML([
  {
    op: "Parametrise C: z(t) = t(1+i), 0 ≤ t ≤ 1",
    eq: "z(t) = t + it, \\quad dz = (1+i)\\,dt, \\quad \\bar{z}(t) = t - it = t(1-i)"
  },
  {
    op: "Substitute into the integral",
    eq: "\\int_C \\bar{z}\\,dz = \\int_0^1 t(1-i)(1+i)\\,dt = \\int_0^1 t(1-i^2)\\,dt = \\int_0^1 2t\\,dt"
  },
  {
    op: "Evaluate",
    eq: "\\int_C \\bar{z}\\,dz = 2\\cdot\\frac{1}{2} = 1"
  },
  {
    op: "Compare with ∫_C z dz (which IS path-independent)",
    eq: "\\int_C z\\,dz = \\left[\\frac{z^2}{2}\\right]_0^{1+i} = \\frac{(1+i)^2}{2} = \\frac{2i}{2} = i",
    note: "z dz = d(z²/2) since z² is analytic. But z̄ is not analytic, so z̄ dz is path-dependent and gives a real answer 1 here."
  }
])
```

---

### Exercise 2: Cauchy's theorem — zero integral

Show that $\displaystyle\oint_C \frac{e^z}{z^2+4}\,dz = 0$ where $C$ is the circle $|z| = 1$.

<!-- STEPPER -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
makeStepperHTML([
  {
    op: "Locate the singularities of the integrand",
    eq: "z^2 + 4 = 0 \\implies z = \\pm 2i"
  },
  {
    op: "Check whether singularities lie inside |z| = 1",
    eq: "|2i| = 2 > 1 \\quad \\text{and} \\quad |-2i| = 2 > 1",
    note: "Both poles are outside the contour C."
  },
  {
    op: "Apply Cauchy-Goursat theorem",
    eq: "f(z) = \\frac{e^z}{z^2+4} \\text{ is analytic everywhere inside } |z|=1",
    note: "No singularities inside C, so the domain enclosed is simply connected and f is analytic there."
  },
  {
    op: "Conclude",
    eq: "\\oint_{|z|=1}\\frac{e^z}{z^2+4}\\,dz = 0"
  }
])
```

---

### Exercise 3: Cauchy's integral formula

Evaluate $\displaystyle\oint_C \frac{e^z}{z - 1}\,dz$ where $C$ is the circle $|z| = 2$ (counterclockwise).

<!-- STEPPER -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
makeStepperHTML([
  {
    op: "Identify z₀ and check it is inside C",
    eq: "\\text{Integrand} = \\frac{f(z)}{z-z_0} \\text{ with } f(z) = e^z,\\; z_0 = 1",
    note: "|z₀| = 1 < 2, so z₀ = 1 is inside |z| = 2. f(z) = e^z is analytic everywhere."
  },
  {
    op: "Apply Cauchy's integral formula",
    eq: "\\oint_C \\frac{e^z}{z-1}\\,dz = 2\\pi i\\,f(1) = 2\\pi i\\,e"
  }
])
```

---

### Exercise 4: Derivative formula

Evaluate $\displaystyle\oint_C \frac{\cos z}{(z - \pi)^2}\,dz$ where $C: |z| = 4$ (counterclockwise). The integrand has a pole at $z = \pi$ inside $C$, so Cauchy's theorem alone cannot give zero — you need the derivative formula.

<!-- STEPPER -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
makeStepperHTML([
  {
    op: "Recognise the derivative formula with n=1",
    eq: "\\oint_C \\frac{f(z)}{(z-z_0)^{n+1}}\\,dz = \\frac{2\\pi i}{n!}\\,f^{(n)}(z_0)"
  },
  {
    op: "Identify f(z) = cos z, z₀ = π, n = 1",
    eq: "\\text{Need } f'(\\pi) = -\\sin(\\pi) = 0"
  },
  {
    op: "Apply the formula",
    eq: "\\oint_C \\frac{\\cos z}{(z-\\pi)^2}\\,dz = \\frac{2\\pi i}{1!}\\,f'(\\pi) = 2\\pi i \\cdot 0 = 0",
    note: "The integral is zero not because the integrand is analytic inside C (it has a pole at π), but because the numerator's derivative vanishes at the pole."
  }
])
```

### Exercise 5: ML inequality estimate

Without evaluating it exactly, show that $\displaystyle\left|\oint_C \frac{dz}{z^3}\right| \leq \frac{\pi}{4}$, where $C$ is the upper semicircle $|z| = 2$ from $z = 2$ to $z = -2$.

<!-- STEPPER -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
makeStepperHTML([
  {
    op: "Identify M = max|f(z)| on C",
    eq: "f(z) = z^{-3}, \\quad |f(z)| = |z|^{-3} = 2^{-3} = \\tfrac{1}{8} \\text{ on } |z|=2"
  },
  {
    op: "Compute the arc length L",
    eq: "C \\text{ is a semicircle of radius } 2 \\implies L = \\pi\\cdot 2 = 2\\pi"
  },
  {
    op: "Apply the ML inequality",
    eq: "\\left|\\oint_C \\frac{dz}{z^3}\\right| \\leq M\\cdot L = \\frac{1}{8}\\cdot 2\\pi = \\frac{\\pi}{4}",
    note: "The actual value (by a direct computation or the residue theorem) is 0, since z^{−3} = d(−z^{−2}/2)/dz is analytic away from the origin and the origin is not enclosed."
  }
])
```

<!-- STUDENT REVIEW
## Chapter 02 — Complex integration
Layer: engineering

### Confusion points

1. **"Piecewise smooth" undefined** (§ Contours and contour integrals). The term appears in the first definition in the chapter and is not explained. Engineers who've seen real line integrals will guess the meaning but it should be stated once.

2. **Product expansion from ∫f dz to two real line integrals is skipped** (§ Contours and contour integrals). The chapter says the contour integral is a "real line integral in disguise" and then immediately displays the expanded form. Showing the multiplication (u+iv)(dx+idy) explicitly, even in one line, would make this genuinely transparent.

3. **Deformation principle: precondition not restated at point of use** (§ Cauchy's integral formula, proof sketch). The proof shrinks C to C_ε "by the deformation principle" without noting that f must be analytic in the annular region between them. A reader might wonder whether deformation always works.

4. **Worked example: two key steps compressed** (§ Application: real integrals via contour integration). The single worked example in the chapter skips both the ML-inequality argument for the semicircle vanishing and the intermediate algebra for applying the integral formula. This is the only example and it's doing a lot of work.

5. **Hook: "the real-plane curl of the field (u, −v) is zero"** (§ hook). An engineering student reading this will reach for the vector-calculus curl ∇×F. The connection to the C-R equations via Green's theorem is non-obvious without more setup. The engineer-prof already flagged this; from a student perspective it creates confusion before the chapter has begun.

### Reassurance gaps

- Liouville's theorem and the fundamental theorem of algebra appear as consequences with proof sketches but without any worked example. After deriving powerful tools, a reader wants to see them used. The section stops short.

- The ML inequality is stated and its real analogue cited, but there is no brief example showing it being applied in the body — it only appears in Exercise 5. A one-line application in the body would confirm the reader knows how to use it.

### Exercise calibration

- Exercises 1–5 are well-matched to the chapter material and the engineering layer.
- Exercise 1 (direct computation of ∫z̄ dz) is a good first exercise — concrete and instructive.
- Exercise 4 (derivative formula) is the hardest; the note about "the integral is zero not because the integrand is analytic" is a potential confusion point. A reader might be puzzled that a zero result from the derivative formula looks identical to a zero result from Cauchy's theorem — the note addresses this but it's at the end of the stepper, after the result is already given.

### Wayfinding

- The hook opens by announcing the residue theorem is "the subject of the next chapter" but does not mention Chapter 4 (conformal mapping). Fine — but worth confirming this chapter's `opens_to` is accurate (it only lists one downstream node).

## Verdict: READABLE WITH FIXES

The chapter's conceptual structure is sound and the exercises are well-calibrated. The main friction points are the elided algebra in the "disguise" expansion and the thin worked example that compresses the two most important techniques (ML inequality and Cauchy formula) into a single paragraph. For a first-time reader, these are the moments most likely to cause loss of thread.
-->
